hints.title: Staircase Frequency Definition
hints.text: For k distinct values appearing in order, the total length must be 1 + 2 + ... + k = k * (k + 1) // 2.

hints.title: Distinct Order Validation
hints.text: Track the sequence of distinct values as they first appear in the candidate subarray.

hints.title: Frequency Matching Condition
hints.text: Verify whether the m-th distinct value appears exactly m times in the subarray for all 1 <= m <= k.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Enumerates start points with triangular length bounds.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining arbitrary frequency combinations without length matching is inefficient.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash maps and arrays bounded by distinct alphabet size.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses triangular number property to break early when subarray length exceeds required sum.
